preamble: Close-mid [o] is lowered to open-mid [ɔ] as a positional allophone, typically in closed syllables. In Javanese /o/ is [ɔ] in closed syllables and in an open syllable followed by an open syllable with i or u (kori [kɔri] 'gate'), but [o] elsewhere (loro [loro] 'two').

examples.note: The closed final syllable has [ɔ]; compare loro [loro] 'two', with [o] in open syllables.

languageExamples.context: Closed syllables, and open syllables before an open syllable with i or u
